transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Occupational health sent me, mostly. They think I’m not eating enough. I don’t know… most days it’s black coffee, maybe a plain yogurt, or a few bites of chicken at night. A full meal just feels like… like I’m letting my standards slip.
Do you have a strong fear of gaining weight, or do you do anything specific to avoid gaining weight, like excessive exercise or avoiding certain foods?
Yeah… I guess so. If the scale is up even half a pound, I get this… jolt. Like I’ve lost control. Then I’ll cut back harder that day. I just… I can’t stand the idea of putting weight back on.
Do you ever make yourself sick or use laxatives after eating to control your weight?
No… I don’t do that. I just try not to eat much in the first place.
Has your low food intake been mostly due to a desire to lose weight or stay thin, or is it more about not feeling hungry or interested in food?

It’s more… intentional, I suppose. I’m not just forgetting to eat. I keep it to coffee, maybe yogurt, or a bit of chicken because a proper meal feels like I’m slipping. Like I’m not keeping myself in line.
Do you judge yourself harshly based on your body shape or weight?

Yeah. I mean… I don’t like saying it, but yes.

When I look in the mirror, I don’t really see what other people say. I just zero in on my stomach, my waist… and if I don’t look lean enough, it sort of ruins how I feel about myself that day.
Would you say that your weight or shape has a strong influence on how you feel about yourself overall?

Yes… it does. More than I’d like to admit.

If I look in the mirror and my stomach or waist doesn’t look right to me, then… it affects the whole day. I don’t really take in what other people say. I just judge myself on whether I look lean enough. Like that decides if I can respect myself or not.
Have you ever felt that your self-worth is entirely tied up with how lean or thin you appear?

Yeah… I think so.

I don’t like putting it that way, but when I look in the mirror, I don’t really see what other people say. I just focus on my stomach, my waist… and if I don’t look lean enough, it feels like I can’t really respect myself that day.
Have you noticed any changes in your menstrual cycle, like periods becoming irregular or stopping altogether?
I… no, that doesn’t really apply to me. I’m male.
